data.rationale: The proposed steps match the true path (Menu > Agencies > Bridges & Tunnels > Tolls by vehicle > vehicle card) and include vehicle_type, but it omits the facility parameter, gives two alternative navigation routes, and ends with a vague "Read toll rates", so a automation would be mostly buildable but incomplete.
